newsitem.title: USA: Com/Tech says SEC files against underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Com/Tech says SEC files against underwriter.

text.p: Com/Tech Communication Technologies Inc said the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has filed a complaint against Sterling Foster & Co, a former underwriter of the company's stock.
Com/Tech said the complaint alleges that Sterling manipulated the stock price of six companies, including Com/Tech.
Com/Tech said Sterling's offices were searched Monday by U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation and U.S. Postal agents.
The company said it was not named as a defendant in the SEC complaint against Sterling.
A Sterling officials said the firm had no comment on the matter.
Com/Tech said it learned of the SEC action of Friday through "published reports."
